observation: The initial self-shape implementation encoded the complete governed lifecycle directly in GitHub Actions and repeated the changed-file list for plan and report. That made CI the owner of process logic and created another place where the lifecycle could drift.

evidence.command: pending: Agent-loop shapes itself after extracting tools/self-shape-dogfood.sh
evidence.summary: Validation is pending. The candidate will be promoted only if the local runner derives the changed-file scope from Git and the full CI/self-shape/release-set matrix remains green.

hypothesis: CI should invoke a repository-owned dogfood runner rather than define the governed lifecycle itself; deriving scope from Git should also remove duplicated file lists without changing behavior.
